description: Writes one value of a site's store, replacing any there was — the site's functions read it on their next call. Only when the person asked: a value they did not mean to change is gone. A value is text up to 64 KiB; refused while the store is full or the month's store operations are spent. Never write back a value store_get answered with `truncated: true`: it is only the start of what is stored, and writing it would cut the rest off for good.

key.description: The key, as store_list shows it. Up to 512 bytes; any characters, `:` and `/` included.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

value.description: The value, as text. Up to 64 KiB.

name: store_put
title: Write a store value
